title: No Chance against the Enemy
front_description: "This is not going well at all," observes a nervous Nute Gunray in the Geonosian command center as Republic troops begin to gain the upper hand. Count Dooku announces that he is retreating to Coruscant to confer with his Master. But before he leaves he is given a vital holographic schematic. "The Jedi must not find our designs for the ultimate weapon," Poggle the Lesser tells him. "If they find out what we're planning to build, we're doomed."
back_description: The unnamed schematic is revealed to be the deadly Death Star.
